name: SolCard Full Access
summary: A high-limit virtual Visa card with Apple and Google Pay support, designed for verified users seeking lower fees.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Full KYC, including proof of address, required
Virtual card only — no physical card

faq.question: Does the SolCard Full Access charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: Yes — it charges US$1 per month. Card issuance is US$10.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the SolCard Full Access?
faq.answer: It charges about 2% on non-base-currency spending.

faq.question: What KYC does the SolCard Full Access require?
faq.answer: It requires a government ID plus proof of address.
